metadata.description: Plugins for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot: my-react (React/TS contract flow + driver agents), my-flutter (Flutter/Dart rules + skills), my-spec (gated prompt-to-output workflow with critique and language-agnostic architecture views). Install any subset with setup.py.

plugins.name: my-react
plugins.description: React/TS spec-driven workflow: driver-embedded phase process, contract skills, atlas auditor, driver + worker agents.

plugins.name: my-flutter
plugins.description: Flutter/Dart spec-driven skills: AC authoring, architecture design (P1–P8), Riverpod, test quality, PR review.

plugins.name: my-spec
plugins.description: Workflow from a prompt to the final output, language- and framework-agnostic: start (fast track for small changes) → explore → decide (only the design parts a task needs) → build or write → critique; follows your project's patterns; builder, writer, designer, explorer, reviewer agents.
